text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Do you understand?! This is the power of the ruler of the night!
text_block_list.orig_text:
思い知ったか！
これが夜を統べる者の力じゃ！

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: Now you know, don't you? This is the beauty of the ruler of beauty♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
思い知ったでしょ？
これが美を統べる者の美しさだよ♪

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: ...I'm not satisfied with the fact that I've become the one in charge of power.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……なんかわらわが力担当になっとるみたいで釈然とせんのじゃが。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: Really? Illya the Power, and I’m cute one. Isn’t that a good balance?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう？
パワーのイリヤ、
キュートなボク。
いいバランスじゃない？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Is there any value in cuteness in battle...? Who cares about that?! The enemy hasn't disappeared yet. Let's keep going!
text_block_list.orig_text:
戦いにおいてキュートさに価値があるのかのう……？
ってそんなことどうでもよいわ！
敵の気配はまだ消えておらん。
この先へ進むぞ！
